verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Floot projects are real TypeScript/React apps that can be read or exported, and a dedicated self-hosting doc confirms you can export code and database and deploy wherever you like, with SQL dumps available on any plan. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that an exported project actually runs standalone without Floot-specific backend services (e.g., managed Postgres, auth broker) needing reconfiguration.
